### 4 October 2026 — provisional Step 4 evidence review and decision

Keep the 196,090-cell common footprint as a labelled population/composition sensitivity; there is no effect-based basis yet for replacing the primary geography or issuing a robustness/scale verdict.

Report released ranges and descriptive date extrema, geography/context shifts, sparse-control rank failures, unverified available-support difference intervals and weather/time limits. Do not treat descriptive extrema as formal date influence or infer named neighbourhood effect drivers from support maps. Preserve all48 non-estimable joint draws without replacement or control removal. No new fit, bootstrap, sealed-file/raw-thermal access, empirical time/window contrast, threshold or numeric simulation-effect range occurred. The original cooling-level ranges and 0.10K SE benchmark supply neither a temporal calibration effect nor Reza tolerance.

Recommend a separately requested/frozen predictor-only canopy endpoint/covariate-support and protected-design rank audit as the next bounded preparation. This review neither executes that audit nor authorizes Step5 model fits. Quadratic fitting, new temporal inference, numeric calibration and study expansion remain held pending applicable quantitative/support/uncertainty review and recorded scope decisions. Reza tolerance remains null; effect-dependent Stage1 conclusions and professor approval remain pending.
